name: Nuki Nuki Literature Club
source: Your good old literature club... but in remote Russian hillbilly village! No books, nobody is smart, nobody can read, but everyone is shapka. Glitchy as heaven. Call yourself lucky if you manage it to the end. äàæå íå äóìàé
